paragraphs.source_en: “Ready! Aim!” Kyūhachirō dared not raise his voice; he merely flicked his hand swiftly.

units.source_en: Kyūhachirō dared not raise his voice; he merely flicked his hand swiftly.
units.source_zh: 九八郎不敢大声，只是飞快地挥了一下手。

paragraphs.source_zh: “准备！瞄准！”九八郎不敢大声，只是飞快地挥了一下手。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, the sky cleared and the mist dispersed, revealing a torrent surging through the gorge as brilliant sunlight bathed both banks in extraordinary splendor.

units.source_en: Before long, the sky cleared and the mist dispersed, revealing a torrent surging through the gorge as brilliant sunlight bathed both banks in extraordinary splendor.
units.source_zh: 很快，天晴了，雾霭散去，只见激流穿越峡谷，奔腾而去，明媚的阳光照着两岸，格外壮丽。

paragraphs.source_zh: 很快，天晴了，雾霭散去，只见激流穿越峡谷，奔腾而去，明媚的阳光照着两岸，格外壮丽。

paragraphs.source_en: “Bang, bang...” At the gunshots, the two ropes snapped. The echoes answered one another like a hundred peals of thunder. The men suspended from the two ropes came crashing down, landing squarely on the soldiers who had just made it across to the bank.

units.source_en: “Bang, bang...” At the gunshots, the two ropes snapped.
units.source_zh: “砰，砰……”随着枪响，两条绳索应声而断。

units.source_en: The echoes answered one another like a hundred peals of thunder.
units.source_zh: 回声相呼应，如同百雷轰鸣。

units.source_en: The men suspended from the two ropes came crashing down, landing squarely on the soldiers who had just made it across to the bank.
units.source_zh: 悬挂在两条绳上的人哗啦一下掉了下去，正砸在刚刚渡到岸边的士兵身上。

paragraphs.source_zh: “砰，砰……”随着枪响，两条绳索应声而断。回声相呼应，如同百雷轰鸣。悬挂在两条绳上的人哗啦一下掉了下去，正砸在刚刚渡到岸边的士兵身上。

paragraphs.source_en: “Aah...” Cries of agony rose from below. Kyūhachirō watched without betraying the slightest emotion and said quietly, “Shot is precious. Save it for later.”

units.source_en: “Aah...” Cries of agony rose from below.
Kyūhachirō watched without betraying the slightest emotion and said quietly, “Shot is precious. Save it for later.”
units.source_zh: 九八郎不动声色地盯着，低声说道：“枪弹珍贵，留着以后再打。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊……”惨叫声从下面传了上来。九八郎不动声色地盯着，低声说道：“枪弹珍贵，留着以后再打。”
